name: watchdog-kit
description: Builds a report-only production watchdog for the app in the current repo: a doors contract, deterministic checks, a grounded model review, a findings page with human verdicts, and an eval against the client's own incident history. User-invoked only; never deploys.

interface.shortDescription: Build a report-only production watchdog for the app in this repo
interface.longDescription: Run /watchdog-build in a client repo. The kit surveys the app's doors (webhooks, provider calls, crons), writes a contract a human approves, then builds deterministic checks on a SELECT-only role, a grounded model review, a findings page with human verdicts, and an eval against the client's own incident history. It reports; it never sends, never deploys and never reads .env values.
defaultPrompt: Run $watchdog-build to start the watchdog survey for this app.
